title: Chapter 257: The Ghost's Changing Room
html:
As Gu Feiyu hefted Doctor Skull-cracker’s heavy hammer, his gaze settled on the stain darkening its head. The sharp scent of blood reached his nose.

“Are all the props in your Haunted House this realistic?”

“Our Haunted House. Now hurry and put it on.” The park opened at nine, leaving Chen Ge little time. Once dressed, Gu Feiyu turned toward the mirror and could hardly believe that the monster reflected there was him.

“Not bad. The look suits you.” Chen Ge nodded in satisfaction. Gu Feiyu was about his height, but his unfamiliarity with the costume made his movements clumsy. “The mask adheres to your skin, so use your facial muscles to change its expression.”

Gu Feiyu attempted a smile, but the result looked more irritated than frightening.

“You’re playing a deranged murderer—a madman. Let me see that madness!” Chen Ge demonstrated several approaches. He had met plenty of madmen, and within seconds, he shifted through several distinct styles. “First, find the type that suits you. After all, madness comes in many forms.

“The easiest is the silent, cold-blooded type. Stay calm no matter what happens. Imagine yourself as an emotionless killing machine.

“One level above that is the bestial type. Make the visitors feel as though you’re always waiting just around the next corner. They are your prey. They may struggle, but they can never escape you.

“Hardest is the truly deranged type. It frightens visitors most, but it also demands greater acting skill. The madness has to inhabit both your eyes and your body. You are a wildfire without thought or reason, driven only to consume everything.”

Chen Ge’s experience with every variety of madman lent his Haunted House a peculiar authenticity. Thoroughly overwhelmed, Gu Feiyu could only keep nodding.

“You’re new, so I won’t expect too much yet.” Chen Ge found Xiaoxiao and led Gu Feiyu to the Murder by Midnight scenario. “You went through the entire scenario yesterday. Do you remember the routes?”

At the reminder of the previous day’s nightmare, tears welled in Gu Feiyu’s eyes. “No. I was too frightened to remember anything.”

“A qualified Haunted House employee must know the layout. Visitors should believe you aren’t human but a lingering spirit—a crazed murderer who could appear at any moment!” Chen Ge strode confidently into the scenario while Gu Feiyu followed with the hammer clutched in both hands.

“I’ll show you all the hidden passages again. Remember them this time,” Chen Ge said solemnly. “There’s another reason you need to know these routes. If a visitor gets into trouble, you must reach them immediately. In here, we are both demons and angels.”

“I don’t think I can do this. Just walking inside makes me uneasy. The thought of staying alone in such a huge place for hours terrifies me.” Despite the ghastly skin mask, tears trembled in Gu Feiyu’s voice. “I still don’t think I’m right for this job.”

“Pull yourself together! How can you surrender without even trying?” Chen Ge met Gu Feiyu’s eyes. “Everything takes time. Being afraid at first is normal. Once you grow accustomed to that fear, you’ll be fine.”

Chen Ge handed him Xiaoxiao from his pocket. “Whatever happens inside the scenario, don’t panic. This little one will protect you.”

With Yin Xiaoxiao in one hand, Gu Feiyu was prepared to believe anything Chen Ge told him. Chen Ge familiarized him with every hidden passage and trap in Murder by Midnight, then taught him basic scare techniques: how closely to follow visitors to build pressure and how to exploit their blind spots. At 8:40 a.m., he left Gu Feiyu waiting alone inside the scenario.

Alone in the scenario, Gu Feiyu hugged the hammer and Xiaoxiao. He leaned against a corner, stared down the eerie corridor, and slowly slid to the floor. “A few months ago, I was planting rice in the fields. The big city is too complicated. I miss Grandma’s cooking…”

After closing the door to Murder by Midnight, Chen Ge heard a commotion outside the Haunted House. Several workers were hanging a banner.

“Chen Ge!” Uncle Xu, who was speaking with a broad middle-aged man beneath the rest tent, waved when Chen Ge emerged from the Haunted House.

“Uncle, you’re early today.”

“Today is the day our park begins its comeback. Of course I came early.” Uncle Xu beamed, clearly in high spirits. “This is Foreman Yang. He’ll be building your rest area, so take any questions or requests to him.”

“Just call me Uncle Yang.” The middle-aged man appeared friendly.

The meeting reminded Chen Ge of something. “Foreman Yang, I do have one favor to ask.”

“Director Luo told me to follow your instructions. What do you need?”

“Please secure both entrances to the park’s underground garage as soon as possible. Don’t seal them permanently, but make it difficult for anyone to wander in or out.”

At present, only large objects blocked the entrances, leaving gaps wide enough for people to squeeze through.

“All right. No problem.” Uncle Xu knew that Director Luo had leased the underground garage to Chen Ge free of charge, so he raised no objection.

“Thank you in advance. I need to inspect the scenarios before we open.” Chen Ge returned to the Haunted House and took out the black phone.

A night has passed; the expansion should be ready by now.

He tapped the screen and found two unread messages.

“Second expansion successful! Unique facility obtained—the Ghost’s Changing Room.

“Another expansion, and the Haunted House will upgrade to Maze of Terror!

“The Ghost’s Changing Room: Police officers who wandered into a haunted tower, students abandoned at school, reporters who visited a hospital at night, patients who lost their memories—here, visitors can relive these characters’ experiences. The Ghost’s Changing Room provides costumes that will greatly increase immersion!

“Warning: The Ghost’s Changing Room has a one-percent chance of triggering an extreme experience! The visitor will enter a memory that is not their own and experience an otherwise irreproducible terror!”
